question: Who has been named the 37th Test captain of India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Shubman Gill**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Shubman Gill becomes Team India’s new Test Captain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **BCCI** announced India's squad for the upcoming **Test series against England**.

 
 
• 
 
**Shubman Gill** has been named the **37th Test captain** of India.

 
 
• 
 
**Rishabh Pant** is the new **vice-captain**.

 
 
• 
 
At **25 years old**, Gill is one of the youngest Test captains in recent years.

 
 
• 
 
This marks a **new era** for Indian cricket after the **retirements of Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma** from Test matches.
